statement: AMD has secured gigawatt-scale Instinct commitments across Microsoft, OpenAI (6 GW), Meta (up to 6 GW) and Oracle (50,000-GPU Helios cluster).
why: A broadening roster of hyperscale customers committing multi-gigawatt Instinct deployments expands AMD's merchant-GPU design-win base.

impact.mechanism: Multiple large-scale customer commitments increase AMD's addressable accelerator demand.

evidence.excerpt: OpenAI - committed to 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs; Meta - deploying up to 6 GW of Instinct GPUs with custom MI450-based silicon; Oracle - building 50,000-GPU Helios supercluster

confidence.basis: Single secondary source summarizing customer roster; not a primary filing.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: Yahoo Finance (24/7 Wall St.)
